meta.name: opencode-qa
meta.description: QA opencode itself, per case: verify the CLI/terminal (opencode run, db, serve, export), prove a specific plugin hook/action/event fired via the SSE event stream, smoke-test the TUI under tmux, and investigate sessions in opencode's SQLite DB by id, title/name, or message text. Ships tested helper scripts (each with a --self-test) plus per-domain references. Use whenever someone wants to QA, smoke-test, verify, or debug opencode's CLI, HTTP server, plugin hooks/events, or TUI, or to find/inspect opencode sessions in the database. Triggers: opencode qa, qa opencode, test opencode, verify opencode hook, opencode session db, find opencode session by id/name/text, opencode tui test, opencode server health, opencode event stream.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 这个技能让Claude能对 opencode 软件做质量检查：验证命令行命令是否正常、事件是否触发、界面能否启动，还能按编号、标题或内容在数据库里查找会话。附带的脚本可自动完成这些检查。
howto.when: 当用户提到“opencode qa”、“test opencode”等关键词，或要求验证opencode的钩子事件、测试TUI界面、查找数据库会话时触发。
howto.what_en: Lets the AI QA opencode itself: verify CLI commands, server/plugin events, TUI smoke-test, and DB session lookup via bundled scripts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says 'opencode qa', 'test opencode', etc., or asks to verify opencode's hooks/events, smoke-test the TUI, or search sessions in the database.

say_en.text: Run 'opencode run' with 'list files in src' and confirm it returns JSON events.
say_en.note: Executes the command and emits structured events for verification.

say_en.text: Run the sse-hook-probe script and verify the server.connected event fires.
say_en.note: Starts an isolated server and asserts the event stream works.

say_en.text: Find the newest 50 sessions whose messages contain 'permission denied'.
say_en.note: Performs a scoped text search and returns matching sessions.
